Security Command Center Officer – 77042


Security Command Center Officer – Houston, TX 77042

$15.84/Hour | Thursday–Sunday | 40 Hours/Week

United Protective Services is seeking a professional and dependable Security Command Center Officer to support daily security operations in the Westchase area of Houston.

This is a computer-focused, customer service-driven security position for someone who is highly detail-oriented, comfortable with technology, and confident communicating with clients and security personnel.

Schedule & Pay

Pay: $15.84 per hourHours: 40 hours per week

Schedule:

  • Thursday: 3:00 PM–11:00 PM
  • Friday: 3:00 PM–11:00 PM
  • Saturday: 7:00 PM–7:00 AM
  • Sunday: 7:00 PM–7:00 AM

Job Responsibilities

  • Monitor security cameras, alarms, access-control systems, and other security technology
  • Dispatch and communicate with security officers and site personnel
  • Maintain professional communication with the client and provide timely updates regarding security activity and incidents
  • Receive and respond to calls, radio communications, and security-related requests
  • Accurately document incidents, activities, and important information
  • Monitor and respond to alarms and security system notifications
  • Maintain accurate daily logs, reports, and records
  • Follow established procedures and appropriately escalate incidents
  • Communicate professionally with clients, employees, visitors, and security personnel

Job Skills / Requirements

  • Heavy customer service experience is required
  • Strong computer proficiency is required
  • Excellent attention to detail is required
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to multitask and remain focused in a fast-paced environment
  • Professional and confident communication with clients and security personnel
  • Ability to learn and operate security systems, software, and technology
  • Dispatch or Command Center experience is preferred
  • Reliable attendance and professional appearance

If you have heavy customer service experience, strong computer skills, and excellent attention to detail, this is an opportunity to put those skills to work in a professional security operations environment.

Apply today and join United Protective Services!


At United Protective Services, our people are our greatest asset. We are looking for reliable, positive people who want to serve others, and grow in their security careers. In return, we provide training, support, and opportunities you need to succeed.

jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Full Time Unarmed in Mont Belvieu, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Chemical/Petrochemical, and more. As an Access Control Officer at a chemical/petrochemical location, you will help manage site entry, verify credentials, monitor access points, and support a secure environment for personnel and visitors. You will remain visible, communicate professionally, and help deter security-related incidents while delivering exceptional customer service. This driving post requires a valid driver’s license in the job state. Join Allied Universal’s agile, reliable team and contribute with integrity and care.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $20.61 / Hour

Driver's License

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to employees, contractors, and visitors by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, access-control requirements, and, when appropriate, emergency response activities.
  • Monitor entry and exit points at a chemical and petrochemical location, verify credentials and access authorizations, and maintain visitor, contractor, and vehicle records.
  • Respond to access-control alarms, incidents, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, promptly notifying appropriate site contacts and/or emergency personnel.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of assigned areas, including building entrances, gates, parking areas, and perimeter locations, while reporting unusual conditions and helping to deter unauthorized access.
  • Follow site protocols for restricted areas, personal protective equipment requirements, and hazardous-materials-related access procedures.

Minimum Requirements

  • A valid driver’s license is required in the state where the job is located.
  • A Guard Card/License is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.

  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

jobs.description:
Security High Rise Lobby Officer- 77042


Security High Rise Lobby Officer – Westchase 77042

$19.52/Hour | Monday–Friday | 6:00 AM–3:00 PM | 45 Hours/Week

Are you professional, dependable, and great with people? United Protective Services is looking for a Security Lobby Officer who thrives in a heavy customer service environment and takes pride in creating professional and welcoming experience for employees, visitors, and clients.

This is a highly visible, client-facing security position requiring frequent interaction with the client and property guests. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, computer-literate, professional, and confident communicating with people throughout the day.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide exceptional customer service and professional assistance to employees, visitors, guests, and clients.
  • Interact directly with the client and maintain a positive, professional working relationship.
  • Serve as a professional and welcoming presence in the lobby.
  • Monitor lobby activity, access points, cameras, and security systems.
  • Verify visitors and assist with access-control procedures.
  • Use computers, email, Microsoft Office, and security-related software for daily tasks and reporting.
  • Accurately document incidents, activities, and other required information
  • Respond professionally to questions, concerns, and security-related situations.
  • Follow site procedures while maintaining strong attention to detail.

Job Skills / Requirements

  • Strong customer service experience is required
  • Heavy customer service and direct client interaction experience preferred
  • Highly detail-oriented with the ability to identify and address small issues
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong computer literacy and ability to learn new software and technology
  • Professional appearance, positive attitude, and excellent interpersonal skills
  • Security, hospitality, concierge, receptionist, or front-desk experience preferred
  • Reliable attendance and ability to work the full scheduled shift

If you enjoy working with people, interacting directly with clients, paying attention to detail, and providing exceptional customer service, this is an opportunity to build your career in a professional security environment.

Apply today and join United Protective Services!


At United Protective Services, our people are our greatest asset. We are looking for reliable, positive people who want to serve others, and grow in their security careers. In return, we provide training, support, and opportunities you need to succeed.
